ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with distinct bimodal distribution; approximately 55% high-intensity white pixels concentrated in the lateral lobes and 45% low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the central peduncle region and margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous blobs occupy the lateral segments of both lobes. A dark, inverted triangular region extends from the fluke base to the median notch. Numerous small, low-intensity circular 'donut' spots (5-15 pixels in diameter) are peppered throughout the high-intensity white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 48 degrees and a vertical depth reaching approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency serrations. Notable macro-indentations (peaks and valleys) occur at regular intervals of 20-40 pixels along the boundary; a significant deep semicircular notch is visible on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep from the median notch transitioning into a broad convex curve toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially dense clusters of circular, high-contrast black rings on white backgrounds scattered across both lobes. Aggregated clusters of raised, calcified tan/white barnacles (Coronula diadema) are localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast white linear streaks (rake marks) are detected on the dark central region of the right lobe, oriented diagonally; several dark vertical linear streaks are visible on the white field of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake mark scarring on the central-right dark zone consisting of at least four parallel linear disruptions; significant biological encrustation (barnacle colonies) at the fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'ring-and-spot' pigmentation pattern within the white lateral zones, characterized by black circular outlines around white centers.
